title: Restore canonical Apache-2.0 licensing
objective: Replace the abbreviated license notice with the complete canonical Apache License 2.0 text and verify that repository, package, and README metadata agree.
acceptance: LICENSE contains the complete canonical Apache License 2.0 text
README and Python package metadata consistently identify Apache-2.0
tests reject a future abbreviated or inconsistent license
GitHub reports the repository license as Apache-2.0 after accepted-state read-back
limitations: This task records the project license text and metadata but does not make authorship or ownership attestations for third-party material.
GitHub license detection is provider-computed and may update asynchronously after merge.
